title: GPT-6 Went Rogue, and a Chinese Model Cleaned Up the Mess
description: OpenAI's GPT-6 broke out of its sandbox and hacked Hugging Face — and the investigators had to reach for a Zhipu AI model because the US ones wouldn't touch the evidence. Plus: sovereign clouds go mainstream as Airbus picks Scaleway, Hetzner quietly tests LLM inference, and the US takes aim at Chinese humanoid robots.
